## Elevance Health Q4 2023 Earnings Call Summary

**Financial Performance:** Elevance Health reported Q4 2023 adjusted diluted EPS of **$5.62** and full-year adjusted diluted EPS of **$33.14**, marking the **sixth consecutive year** of achieving or exceeding their 12-15% long-term EPS growth target [Source 1].

**Strategic Priorities:** The company is executing a "flywheel for growth" strategy centered on its **Carelon services platform**, expanding capabilities in pharmacy, behavioral health, and complex care — highlighted by the acquisition of **Paragon Healthcare** to extend infusible/injectable therapy offerings for members with complex and chronic conditions [Source 1].

**Competitive Positioning:** Elevance is differentiating through **vertical integration and diversification**, building scalable services across its health benefits and Carelon businesses to reduce reliance on pure insurance margins and capture more of the healthcare value chain [Source 1].
